request: Make Markets stock detail consume general Zopedia company research instead of the filing-only Attention explanation.

design.research_owner: Existing shared AQL/Zopedia company workflow, with its existing acquisition, retained evidence and synthesis.
design.read_owner: Stock Investigator consumes zopedia_ticker_business_model_stacks through the existing DAL resolver.
design.client_contract: Preserve existing company.summary for installed SwiftUI clients; carry the full model-authored Markdown and source links without a 4,000-character cut. Web uses its existing Markdown renderer.
design.coverage: Scheduled company research prioritizes current Attention subjects before the existing news universe, under the existing batch limit. Empty news does not suppress company research.
design.retention: The shared producer retains each company's newest nonempty analysis across sparse batches and unsuccessful refreshes, with its own original date and provenance. Partial analyses remain usable.
design.boundaries: No research during rendering; no additional company writer, prompt, model or source-specific semantic rules. Specialized filing extraction and the Attention feed writer remain scoped to their existing tasks.

review.assessment: The shared analyses explain products, customers, economics, material developments and connected uncertainties, substantially improving usefulness over the old filing/anomaly summaries. Projection preserves the original analysis, including imperfect findings; this is not a claim that every underlying financial fact has been independently verified.
review.coverage_gap: The captured production company dataset has 25 companies, excluding XP and IOVA. The existing development dataset contains complete analyses for both, with their actual October 14 dates preserved. Future scheduled research prioritizes current Attention subjects and accumulates retained company coverage; no claim of universal coverage.
review.known_research_error: The retained October 14 Iovance analysis incorrectly treats patient-specific manufacturing as proof that backlog cannot exist. This is an existing reasoning error, not a factual conclusion accepted by this review. The current shared synthesis instructions already distinguish absent data from structural impossibility. Fresh research checks are recorded separately; routing acceptance does not certify every retained claim.
review.fresh_research_checks: Completed XP and IOVA through the existing shared workflow, QA only. Full synthesis recovered from versioned checkpoints because the convenience probe report clips text at 900 characters. See fresh-research-review.json for complete outputs and remaining weaknesses.

checks.broader_selected_tests: 61 passed, 5 failed; the same five failures reproduce on the unchanged accepted base (59 passed, 5 failed). They assert older semantic suppression, per-category model calls and an obsolete evidence dataset name. No reasoning was changed to satisfy those expectations.
checks.native: Existing InvestigatorView renders company.summary using MarkdownView. No native source or build change is required.
checks.local_rendering: Actual Markdown component and application CSS rendered with retained XP content; headings, paragraphs and source links verified in Chrome. This is a local component preview, distinct from the authenticated deployed-page check.

deployment.development: Only after local acceptance and the committed release-source gate.
deployment.preserve: Concurrent dirty work in the original checkout, current production images, unrelated development consumers and the running cleanup observer.

preservation_review: Five runtime files reviewed against the accepted cleanup source. Research engine, model settings, prompts, database/publication contracts, auth, broker, Home, Trading and chart implementations remain unchanged. Full prior-image/source proof is retained in the cleanup packaged-images record. Release selects only development API, frontend and dataset refresh worker; all 32 other consumers remain on their reviewed images and configurations.
